notes:
SMART, the voice engineer, after an honest capability review.

- Race calls are short again: a hard cap per session type (2-8 words in a race, one sentence in qualifying, two in practice).
- Pit calls come from arithmetic: fuel laps, the lap a stop is forced by, the tyre floor and the undercut are computed and handed to SMART. A required stop is never "stay out".
- Setup advice from a damper table, a fast-corner rule and a conditions block, with a self-check before he speaks.
- He knows each corner's speed class and direction from your own reference lap.
- A change ledger: what he suggested, what changed, what the laps did; "did that help?" is answered from the laps. He corrects you if you attribute to him something he did not say.
- Eight turns of memory instead of three.
- "Say again?" when the mic is not confident, before any AI call.
- "Go on" brings back an answer you talked over.
- After an off in a race: information only.
- sr.py smart-eval: a repeatable scored test of SMART's radio scenarios.
